description: This file implements a generic directory cache class (`DirectoryCache`) with methods for getting, setting, clearing, and pruning cache entries, as well as handling configuration changes. It also defines types for cache entries and cache keys, and a utility function for building cache key strings.

classes.description: A generic cache class that stores entries with expiration handling, size limiting, and configuration change detection.
